text.offer: Pietro says, "Kill the soldiers and more come. They've got a king down there, deep in the sewers, a fat old rat who breeds them faster than you can kill them. Find him and kill him."
text.progress: Pietro says, "The rat king keeps to the deeper tunnels of the Sewers of Jasper. Bring friends: his soldiers guard him."
text.complete: Pietro says, "The king's dead? Then my cellar might stay dry a little longer. Here."

steps.objective: The rat king of the Sewers of Jasper slain
